def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Identify the color used for full-line separators.
    row_line_colors = {r: grid[r][0] for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1}
    col_line_colors = {c: grid[0][c] for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1}
    divider = Counter(list(row_line_colors.values()) + list(col_line_colors.values())).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r, color in row_line_colors.items() if color == divider]
    sep_cols = [c for c, color in col_line_colors.items() if color == divider]

    def spans(size, cuts):
        result, start = [], 0
        for cut in cuts:
            if cut > start:
                result.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        if start < size:
            result.append((start, size))
        return result

    row_spans = spans(h, sep_rows)
    col_spans = spans(w, sep_cols)
    counts = Counter(
        grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h)
        for c in range(w)
        if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols
    )
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = min((color for color in counts if color != background), key=lambda color: counts[color])

    output = [[background for _ in col_spans] for _ in row_spans]
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
